observations.note: Nscale -> Anyscale (Ray-based compute platform for AI training, reinforcement learning and inference); sublayer post_training; acquisition; closing is tied to Nscale's IPO. Ledger sweep of 23 Sep 2026.
observations.raw_snippet: Nscale, a full-stack AI cloud platform, today announced it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Anyscale, the platform for scaling any AI workload - data processing, training, inference and reinforcement learning - across thousands of GPUs.
observations.subject: nscale
observations.value_text: agreed to acquire Anyscale (RLaaS / post-training / continual-learning infra)
